name: Littmann Classic II Infant Stethoscope, Raspberry
seoTitle: Littmann Infant Stethoscope for NICU Nurses
metaDescription: The Littmann Classic II Infant stethoscope with a rainbow finish chestpiece and raspberry tube. A thoughtful gift for NICU and newborn nursery nurses.
summary: A Classic II Infant stethoscope with a rainbow finish and raspberry tube, made with the tiniest patients in mind and a fun gift for NICU nurses.
whyItWorks: NICU and newborn nursery nurses work with patients small enough to fit in two hands, and their gear reflects that. An infant stethoscope is sized for the tiniest patients, so it is a gift that shows you understand exactly what their work involves. Adult models are what most people think of first, which makes a stethoscope chosen specifically for neonatal care feel especially thoughtful.

The look matters too. A raspberry tube and rainbow finish chestpiece feel cheerful in a unit where families are often going through stressful days, and it is easy to pick out in a drawer full of standard black models. The title also mentions a brass stem and headset. For a nurse starting a NICU job, finishing a neonatal fellowship, or moving from adult care to babies, it makes a fitting welcome gift. Since many units provide basic equipment, a personal stethoscope like this is often something nurses wish they had but rarely buy for themselves.
goodToKnow: Infant stethoscopes are specialized, so this is best for nurses who actually work with newborns.
Check the listing photos for the rainbow finish, which looks different depending on lighting.
Pair with a cute neonatal themed badge reel for a complete NICU welcome gift.

faq.q: Is this a good gift for a NICU nurse?
faq.a: Yes. It is designed for infants, so it fits NICU, nursery, and neonatal transport nurses well.

faq.q: Can an adult care nurse use an infant stethoscope?
faq.a: It is meant for very small patients, so a nurse working mostly with adults would get more use from an adult or pediatric model.
